web-guide-idea-88.audience: Followers who want room to ask questions about a spiritual theme.
web-guide-idea-88.offer: A knowledgeable teacher facilitates a small discussion with meaningful participation. State how questions are selected and how much time each person gets.
web-guide-idea-88.steps.0: Choose a theme and gather questions.
web-guide-idea-88.steps.1: Offer a short explanation followed by moderated turns.
web-guide-idea-88.steps.2: Summarise different perspectives and a reading or reflection.
web-guide-idea-88.equipment: A phone, quiet room and stable internet. A moderator can help with larger groups.
web-guide-idea-88.returnReason: Follow related themes as a coherent series, without promising spiritual or health outcomes.
web-guide-idea-88.promotion: Name the teacher and topic accurately, using only authorised promotional material.
